name: Gitea app.ini ROOT_URL Check
description: TEST-ONLY. Runs inside the gitea LXC after start. Asserts that a ROOT_URL requested via the `extra_envs` overlay actually landed in /data/gitea/conf/app.ini — end-to-end proof of the extra_envs → envs merge → environment-to-ini → app.ini chain. Skips (passes) when the scenario sets no custom ROOT_URL.
